data_fields.name: valve_tax_row
data_fields.donor_constant: min(cityTax + gameLevel, 20) indexes a 21-row table from 200 to -600

data_fields.name: zone_sample_odds
data_fields.donor_constant: non-empty zones sampled 1 in 8 (mask 7); empty zones always

data_fields.name: population_band_top
data_fields.donor_constant: population below 40 may grow; band steps of 8

data_fields.name: sweep_phases
data_fields.donor_constant: 16 phases per cycle; 8 strips for the zone pass

best_idea: Keep a clamped demand accumulator per zone type, updated on a fixed schedule from last cycle's counts, and sample each zone with a bounded roll while spreading the zone pass over the ticks of a cycle.
decision_why: The clamped valve, cap flag, one-in-N sample and eight-slice sweep fit Frankendom's zone spawn caps; the city economy (tax table, employment, internal market) does not fit the fight-focused world. The server runs the valve and the roll and logs each spawn in the one ledger.
acceptance: A server test: a capped zone's valve never goes above 0; each zone is sampled once per 16-tick cycle; no tick samples more than one eighth of the zone columns; an empty zone past its grace period loses population in steps and never exceeds its band.
